dct_description_sm: The Regional Storm Sewer Network Gravity Main is used for planning and visualization purposes. The location of this infrastructure and attribute information is provided as a reference and should not be used for construction purposes. This data includes Storm Sewer Gravity Mains, Catch basin leads and Culverts (<3m).
